definitions.explanation: A rough idea or estimate of something, often used when one has a general sense of where something is or who is responsible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目星|めぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
examples.english: They have a lead on the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目星|めぼし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I've already got my eye on a place to move to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目星|めぼし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I have a rough idea of the cause, but confirmation is still needed.

notes:
USAGE:
{目星|めぼし} is almost always used with the verb つく or ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧. {目星|めぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく means to get a lead or form an estimate; {目星|めぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ means to single out a target or narrow things down.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目星|めぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (to get a lead, to have an idea)
- {目星|めぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to single out, to set one's sights on)
- {目星|めぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない (to have no lead/clue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{目途|めど}→目途：17245_medo⟧ (also read ⟦{目処|めど}→目処：07286_medo⟧) means a prospect or target date and is more formal. ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧ means a rough estimate or guess.
